description: Dispatch, verify, integrate, recover, report. Bundlebees as the execution system with its two pinned protocol checkouts (workflow, hyvv); Orbit optional as the control surface.

components.role: execution system: dispatch, leases, sandboxed verify, integrate, job store, reconciler, queue, recovery, RETURN
components.why: this is the element being orchestrated with

components.role: protocol source the executor loads validators from at a pinned revision
components.why: packets, recovery and return validation load from the pinned checkout and fail closed when it is missing

components.role: worker host providing the /v1 attempts API and governed provisioning
components.why: the production dispatch path posts attempts to the worker host; CI also requires its pinned source for contract tests

components.role: control surface: boards, sessions, launcher front-end for the default orbit-loopback backend
components.why: a configured launcher URL or a scripted test backend can replace it; the protocol does not require it

env.name: WORKFLOW_SRC
env.note: path to a workflow checkout pinned at the recorded revision; packets and recovery refuse to run without it

env.name: HYVV_SRC
env.note: path to a hyvv checkout pinned at the recorded revision

env.name: REQUIRE_WORKFLOW
env.note: set to 1 so a missing workflow checkout fails instead of skipping

env.name: REQUIRE_HYVV
env.note: set to 1 so a missing hyvv checkout fails instead of skipping

env.name: BUNDLEBEES_REQUIRE_ROUNDTRIP
env.note: turns on the orbit-roundtrip job against pinned Orbit commits

env.name: BUNDLEBEES_ALLOW_WEAK_UNSHARE
env.note: documented-unsafe override that lets verify use unshare; never set in production

env.name: HERMES_M42_REAL
env.note: gates the real-model recovery adapter test; never set in CI

env.name: HERMES_M43_REAL
env.note: gates the real-model wake-up test; never set in CI

ports: none of its own: the coordinator talks to the worker host and the launcher over their loopback or configured endpoints; job state is files on disk
auth_posture: coordinator-held HMAC key files at mode 0600 sign leases, jobs and approvals; the launcher credential is read from the environment only and never logged; the verify sandbox gets no coordinator credentials; merge, push, tag, release, deploy and every gate stay human acts
cannot_do: cannot verify without bubblewrap or firejail: it fails closed with sandbox_unavailable unless the explicitly unsafe local override is set
cannot run its mandatory suite without both pinned checkouts (workflow and hyvv at the recorded revisions)
cannot merge, push, tag, release or deploy by itself; those are human-gated
cannot claim exactly-once dispatch: the launcher has no server-side idempotency; adoption reconciles a lost response instead
cannot enforce parked-project refusals yet: the hyvv gate is a proposal, not running code

refs.path: bundlebees_plugin/adapters.py (the only module allowed to name an agent or launcher)
